P01.note: Right scene, calm sky left for headline. Delivered 1920x1200, not 2400x1500 (same 16:10 shape); good enough for the concept, flag for site-images.

P02.note: Designer, couple and clipboard back only; no text; people right two-thirds.

P03.note: Thin dark frame (about 8 px) trimmed 10 px each side; original in photos/_original/. Hands, stone and hammer believable.

P04.note: Patio, fire pit, teak chairs, seat wall, lights, lit house; no text.

P05.note: Crew member pruning hydrangeas with secateurs, second worker raking, misty sea; subject left, open lawn right.

P06.note: Stone path through grasses and lavender, path lights, lit doorway; dusk sky in the top third. The path is rounded beach cobbles rather than flat fieldstone; it reads as coastal, so accepted.

P07.note: Father and adult son and daughter laughing at a nursery; plain white truck with no lettering; family centre-right.

P08.note: Dune grass, sea lavender and roses in front of weathered shingles. The roses are double garden roses, not the single five-petal beach rose (Rosa rugosa); accepted for the concept, can be redone.
